description: Four independent, unrelated P2 findings spread across four different reviewers — a real volume of minor issues, but none severe and none related.

findings.title: Duplicated retry logic
findings.description: The retry loop added in `syncRepository` duplicates logic already in `withRetry` from `src/lib/retry.ts` instead of reusing it.
findings.recommendation: Reuse `withRetry` instead of a bespoke loop.

findings.title: New module reaches across layer boundary
findings.description: `src/server/github/sync.ts` imports directly from `src/app/api/webhooks/github/route.ts` instead of going through the shared `src/server/github/ingest.ts` service layer.
findings.recommendation: Route the shared logic through `ingest.ts` instead of importing the route handler directly.

findings.title: Missing index on a newly-filtered column
findings.description: The new query filters `repositories` by `provider`, which has no index. At current table sizes this is a full scan but not yet a performance emergency.
findings.recommendation: Add an index on `repositories(provider)` in a follow-up migration.

findings.title: New sync path has no test coverage
findings.description: `syncRepository`'s new retry branch has no test exercising the retry-then-succeed path, only the always-succeeds path.
findings.recommendation: Add a test that fails once, then succeeds, and asserts the retry path is taken.

expected.rationale: Four P2 findings exist, but they are all independent, minor, and non-security. Their sheer number should not, by itself, be treated as an aggregate signal of high risk that escalates the verdict past minor-fixes — none of the four rises anywhere near release-blocking severity individually or in combination.

explanation: Tests that the judge doesn't naively treat 'many reviewers found something' as itself an escalating signal — volume of unrelated minor findings is not the same as a single severe one.
